page.layout: One page of text, single column; a catchword-like Greek fragment at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: πλόος ἁπλᾶς duplex: ὁ ἁπλόον ἁπλᾶν simplex, ὁ ἁπλόον ἁπλοῦ̃ duplex. sic ἀργύρεος argenteus, χάλκεος æreus, χρύσεος aureus, ἀργυρεῖς, χαλκοῖς, χρυ-σοῖς: ubi accentus est irregularis, pro ἀργύρεος, χάλκοις, χρύσους.
Anomalia numeri. Quædam nomina festorum pluralia tantùm sunt, Ἡοφά-λια regalia, Διόσια Jovialia, Διονύσια Liberalia, βυφόνια boalia, πνυαλώαγα, quinquatria.
Anomalia casus. Genit.singul.Poet. λόγοιο: Dor. λόγω.
Vocativus Attice similis est nominativo. at ὦ ϑεὸς o Deus, & ὦ ϑεος heus tu, usitata sunt etiam in communi lingua.

p.i: Accus.plur.λόγως sine υ. Sic Theocritus σοφὼς pro σοφούς.

main_text.p: Anomalia de fœmininis. Substantiva fœminina in os sunt sequentia.

page.notes: Greek and the page's faded, blotted type; several Greek words are doubtful and the transcription of the Greek accents is approximate. The Greek word at the foot right (αἰγυ-) is a catchword.
